task: Separate client Bol worklist into an explicit account tab

producers.source_condition: The authenticated station has two configured fixed account sources and the operator selects a tab.
producers.user_impact: The visible operational worklist and the account used for the next scan change.
producers.recovery: Select Bankhoes or Client Bol before scanning; a tab is disabled while an existing scan decision is resolving.
producers.copy_purpose: Label the safe source-selection control without exposing account identifiers.
producers.external_proof: Browser tab-selection, scoped-row, focus, and accessibility assertions

producers.source_condition: The selected source snapshot is loading, ready, refreshing, stale, or unavailable.
producers.user_impact: The operator can or cannot safely scan the selected account’s packages.
producers.recovery: Wait for a complete snapshot or use the existing Retry/Refresh control.
producers.copy_purpose: Preserve selected-source fail-closed readiness and recovery language.
producers.final_copy: Ready for the next scan / Data needs attention — retry before scanning.

producers.source_condition: A selected-source scan resolves as GO, duplicate, cancelled, unknown, or unverified.
producers.user_impact: The operator needs a clear dispatch or pull-aside action.
producers.recovery: Dispatch GO packages; pull aside STOP packages and resolve them manually.
producers.copy_purpose: Preserve the existing safe package decision.
producers.final_copy: GO — package cleared / STOP — do not send this package.
producers.external_proof: Existing and updated scan-flow browser assertions

producers.source_condition: A native account tab's aria-selected state changes after direct operator input.
producers.user_impact: Assistive-technology users can identify the active source before scanning.
producers.recovery: Use the tab control to select the intended source.
producers.copy_purpose: Expose the same source-selection state to assistive technology.
producers.external_proof: Role, aria-selected, and keyboard-focus browser assertions

producers.source_condition: Periodic refresh and tab rerender mechanics complete without a user-impacting fault.
producers.copy_purpose: Keep non-actionable implementation diagnostics outside product chrome.

what_must_not_appear: Bol client credentials, tokens, account identifiers, or raw upstream payloads
Stack traces, API route errors, Vercel or Turso internals, or test narration
Debug language that treats account-tab mechanics as product content
